name: arus_kas_langsung
query:
WITH
mv AS (
  SELECT
    CASE sk.cash_flow_type WHEN 'investing' THEN 2 WHEN 'financing' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END AS section_urut,
    CASE sk.cash_flow_type
         WHEN 'investing' THEN 'ARUS KAS DARI (UNTUK) AKTIVITAS INVESTASI'
         WHEN 'financing' THEN 'ARUS KAS DARI (UNTUK) AKTIVITAS PENDANAAN'
         ELSE 'ARUS KAS DARI AKTIVITAS OPERASI' END AS section,
    k.code AS akun_kode, k.nama AS akun_nama,
    SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai
  FROM (
    SELECT g.id AS gid, g.tanggal::date AS d, g.department_id AS department_id,
           g.project_id AS project_id, jv.account_id AS account_id,
           jv.cost_code_id AS cost_code_id, jv.debit AS debit, jv.kredit AS kredit
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  JOIN kiraan  k  ON k.id  = G1.account_id
  JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  WHERE COALESCE(k.is_cash,'0') <> '1' {andWhere}
  GROUP BY 1, 2, k.code, k.nama
  HAVING SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit) <> 0
),
kasakhir AS (
  SELECT SUM(jv.debit - jv.kredit)::numeric(18,2) AS kas_akhir
  FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
  JOIN kiraan k ON k.id = jv.account_id
  WHERE g.status = 'approved' AND COALESCE(k.is_cash,'0') = '1'
)
SELECT mv.section_urut, mv.section, mv.akun_kode, mv.akun_nama, mv.nilai,
       (SELECT kas_akhir FROM kasakhir) AS kas_akhir
FROM mv
ORDER BY mv.section_urut, mv.akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}
query_count:
WITH mv AS (
  SELECT 1 AS x
  FROM (
    SELECT jv.account_id AS account_id, jv.debit AS debit, jv.kredit AS kredit,
           g.tanggal::date AS d, g.department_id AS department_id, g.project_id AS project_id,
           jv.cost_code_id AS cost_code_id
    FROM g_jurnal g JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  JOIN kiraan  k  ON k.id  = G1.account_id
  JOIN subklas sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
  WHERE COALESCE(k.is_cash,'0') <> '1' {andWhere}
  GROUP BY sk.cash_flow_type, k.code, k.nama
  HAVING SUM(G1.kredit - G1.debit) <> 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mv
